answer: Private canary prompts expose sock puppets fed from one shared pipeline. First, the node slips each identity a unique hidden detail, say a jade teapot only that key ever sees. Second, graders scan every answer for details issued to someone else. Third, any leak links the accounts and freezes both payouts for ten epochs. Fourth, three links burn the stake. Dodging it means 300 sealed pipelines, each about $48 a month in tokens plus a $5 VPS, so nearly $16,000 monthly. It works like dyeing every velvet glove a secret shade: one stain on two hands is the signal.
